data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to make your window fullscreen and get screen sizes.
data.what_it_does: Allows your application to enter and exit fullscreen mode across multiple platforms. It also provides methods to query logical and physical screen sizes.
use_when: You need to toggle fullscreen mode for your desktop, web, or mobile Flutter app.
You need to retrieve logical or physical screen dimensions.
avoid_when: You are looking for complete window management tools like resizing, moving, or framing desktop windows.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Windows, Linux, Web, Android, and iOS.
Simple imperative API with just a few static methods.
weaknesses: iOS support is untested by the author.
Limited to fullscreen toggling and screen size retrieval.
